definitions.role: base minus reversal in same lexical family
definitions.unrelated: base family i minus base family i+1 modulo four
definitions.lag_mask: off-diagonal Gram entries with |step_i-step_j| at least given lag
definitions.raw_template_residual: subtract mean raw-prompt Gram within model and token site; descriptive only
definitions.cross_site: same-layer cosine between steps at labeled token sites

limitations: Four exposed examples and no independent voice or other task contrast.
Unrelated control has different lexical content; cross-site patterns can be lexical.
Raw-template subtraction can remove real structure and is not validated on holdouts.
Permutation fractions are descriptive with only 24 mappings, not population p-values.
